reviews.review:
Very cute game, would be ideal for 3DS if it came out a decade ago!

It's a simple-at-first on-rails shooter. You "control" 4 characters that go together almost all the time, but sometimes split up. Any action you do, the 4 do it at the same time, so it's more a matter of having to pay attention at several things when they split.

You have a bit of platforming and, of course because it's 2025, a parry move. These things introduce a bit of variety so the game doesn't become just shooting.

Speaking of the shoot, it's basically matching the enemies' colors and choose the best target so the shoot's properties kill more enemies in a chain. It has a very arcade-y feeling and it makes you want to retry the levels to get bigger combos.

Sometimes the perpective gets a bit in the middle of making a chain on the first try, but it can be worked around by replaying the level and learning where to shoot.

Give the demo a try and get the game if you like it!
